description: This source file defines a Spring MVC controller for managing customer options in an admin interface. It includes endpoints for listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting customer options, with role-based access control and support for internationalized descriptions.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling CRUD operations for customer options in the admin backend.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles the listing view of customer options, sets menu context.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific customer option based on its ID.

methods.name: displayOptionCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new customer option.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Shared internal method to prepare the customer option form, either for editing or creating.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles form submission to save or update a customer option, with validation.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Provides a paginated list of customer options in JSON format for frontend data tables.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for the admin UI.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a customer option via AJAX.
